newsitem.title: JAPAN: Orders for Fuji Heavy's Forester exceed target.
newsitem.headline: Orders for Fuji Heavy's Forester exceed target.

text.p: Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd said on Wednesday it had received 4,000 domestic orders for its new Forester light sport-utility vehicle (SUV) in the first 20 days after the vehicles's launch.
Fuji Heavy, owned 4.2 percent by Nissan Motor, introduced the Forester four-wheel-drive SUV on February 13 in Japan with a monthly sales target of 3,000 units.
Meanwhile, domestic orders for Fuji Heavy's mainstay Legacy and Impreza models rose 25 percent in February from a year earlier.
